system_profile.system_purpose: legacy-billing is a Java 8 / Spring Boot web API that accepts HTTP billing requests on /charge, computes invoice totals with tax rules, invokes an external payment gateway for retries, caches billed totals in a static HashMap, and prints audit trails to stdout.
system_profile.domain_context: Customer invoice charging, multi-currency tax calculation (USD/JPY), payment gateway retry integration, and ledger audit logging.
tech_stack: Java 1.8 (pom.xml target, mismatched with Java 11 java.net.http usage)
Spring Boot Web Starter (unpinned LATEST in pom.xml)
external_integrations: External payment gateway HTTP POST endpoint read via System.getenv('LEGACY_PAYMENT_URL') (default https://billing.example.invalid/charge)

structure_map.architecture_pattern: Cyclic Legacy Spring Boot Layered Monolith with Shared Mutable Global/Singleton State

layers.name: Controller Layer
layers.responsibility: HTTP /charge intake using raw Map payloads, @Autowired field injection, and mutable singleton state.

layers.name: Service Layer
layers.responsibility: Batch billing calculation, tax rules, retry orchestration, static INVOICE_CACHE, and audit logging (improperly depends upward on BillingController).

layers.name: Model & Utility Layer
layers.responsibility: Immutable InvoiceRecord DTO and legacy date/tag helper using SimpleDateFormat and Vector.

layers.name: External Client Layer
layers.responsibility: Outbound payment gateway HTTP POST client using Java 11 HttpClient without timeouts and hardcoded GATEWAY_SECRET.

modules.role: REST controller exposing ANY /charge with raw Map and mutable 'channel' field
modules.health_note: Part of runtime cycle with BillingManager; mutable singleton field race condition.

modules.role: Core billing god-service with static INVOICE_CACHE and circular controller injection
modules.health_note: Primary risk hotspot: cognitive=56, 8 params, String ==, empty catch, broken private @Transactional.
Hardcoded secret, Java 11 API on Java 1.8 target, missing timeout, System.getenv.
Cleanest module in repo; 0 AST issues.

structure_map.boundary_assessment: Severe boundary violation: BillingManager imports and @Autowired-injects BillingController, creating a runtime cycle (BillingController <-> BillingManager). Mutable static HashMap INVOICE_CACHE and singleton field BillingController.channel violate statelessness and thread safety.

execution_flows.name: Customer Charge & Batch Billing Flow
steps: BillingController.chargeCustomer() overwrites shared singleton field 'channel' with HTTP method and extracts customerId/amountCents from raw Map payload.
Constructs raw ArrayList containing one InvoiceRecord and calls BillingManager.processBatchBilling() with 8 arguments.

processBatchBilling() checks status=='PAID' and currency=='USD'/'JPY' via == reference equality to apply 8%/10% tax, or invokes GatewayClient.sendCharge(customerId, 100L) in a retry loop for non-positive amounts.

Calls private @Transactional saveAuditTrail() (self-invocation bypasses Spring proxy), writes to static raw HashMap INVOICE_CACHE using LegacyDateHelper, optionally reads circularController.lastChannel(), and swallows exceptions in an empty catch block.

state_and_storage: Unsynchronized process-local static raw HashMap BillingManager.INVOICE_CACHE (src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java:17).
Mutable singleton controller field BillingController.channel overwritten on every HTTP request (src/main/java/com/example/billing/controller/BillingController.java:20).
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Thread-unsafe Servlet container execution: concurrent requests race on BillingController.channel and unsynchronized HashMap INVOICE_CACHE; BillingManager swallows all audit/cache exceptions in an empty catch block (line 83) and GatewayClient prints stack traces to stderr while blocking indefinitely without HTTP timeouts.
